claim.quote: The ArgoNeuT collaboration presents the first measurements of inclusive muon neutrino charged current differential cross sections on argon.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published Phys. Rev. Lett. 108, 161802 (2012).

key_value_text.quote: The data are consistent with the Monte Carlo expectation across the full range of kinematics sampled
key_value_text.value: First inclusive nu_mu CC differential cross sections on argon; data consistent with Monte Carlo across 0 < theta_mu < 36 deg and 0 < P_mu < 25 GeV/c

name: First Measurements of Inclusive Muon Neutrino Charged Current Differential Cross Sections on Argon

summary.plain: ArgoNeuT made the first measurements of how often muon neutrinos interact with argon nuclei and at what angles and energies the muons emerge, confirming that liquid-argon chambers work for neutrino detection and testing the interaction models long-baseline experiments rely on.
summary.technical: Inclusive nu_mu CC differential cross sections on argon in outgoing muon angle (0-36 deg) and momentum (0-25 GeV/c) in the NuMI beam, consistent with Monte Carlo expectation across the sampled kinematics.

title: First Measurements of Inclusive Muon Neutrino Charged Current Differential Cross Sections on Argon
why_it_matters: The first liquid-argon cross-section measurements, a basis for DUNE and the short-baseline programme.
